description.label: Description
description.value:
Trivial Physical Mutation

You gain a small feature from an unnatural source somewhere on your body. Roll on the @Table[hitloc]{Hit Locations} Table to determine which part of the body is affected, and then on the @Table[unnatural-body] Table below to see which type of source that lends its features to you. The alteration is something relatively trivial. On the head an eye or an ear might turn unnatural, whereas on a leg it could be a patch of demonskin or some fernbeast outgrowth between the toes - the GM decides the specifics. The change is entirely cosmetic.
